boundaries: Only selected asset is queried. Public fee needs no login or wallet signature; zero is accepted only if explicitly returned, never synthesized from missing values.
Fee amount and USD estimate are distinct units; quote token price is optional. Platform fee does not estimate wallet transaction gas or authorize withdrawal.
Numeric JSON fee fields are decoded from raw lexemes directly to Decimal; all other existing account/catalog services retain default JSON decoder.
Thirty-second stale state and failed-refresh retention are visible; actual withdrawal must fetch current fee again before confirmation and signing.
Actual deposit/approval/withdraw/transfers, enable-trading, complete subaccounts/Portfolio and Chase/BBO/Scaled remain incomplete. BAPI historical statistics/TWAP skipped at user request.
